slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Rolled the same ankle again? Toto has, and it's a really common pattern.

After a sprain, the ankle can lose some strength and some of its sense of where it is. If rehab stops as soon as the pain fades, it may not react as quickly on an uneven path or an awkward landing.

The good news: balance and strength are trainable. Start with 30 seconds on one leg while brushing your teeth, add single-leg calf raises and band work, then build to small hops and side-to-side drills over several weeks. Handy before summer beach runs.

Trouble taking weight, bony tenderness or frequent giving way are worth getting checked. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can build a stability program for you. Book online via the link in bio.
